facts.fact: Rohan's grandfather, an early warden of the Shilak post, went out in a night storm to check the cairns for a lost party and was found at the thaw; Rohan's father told it that way, and the Closing Law was written the next spring 'for him'. Rohan believes it was an accident.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Rohan to say his grandfather 'died on the pass' and explain why he keeps the law (C14).

facts.fact: The Goat's Teeth is a spine of steep rock on the south-east shoulder of the Long Saddle, with three ledges, two ropes' worth of down-climbing and an ice chimney, dropping to the Neshar side below the third bend. Jassi named it and hated it.
facts.why: needed because the beat names the crew route and its cost of one day.

facts.fact: Firewood stands at twelve dry sticks after Rohan burns one for his silence about the fines, on the night of the hunters' climb.
facts.why: needed to bridge to chapter 15's eleven sticks.
